events.text: Rerun the probe on the live mirror at all 7 widths so the evidence is from this run.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for w in 390 414 768 1024 1280 1440 1920; do echo "== $w"; WIDTH=$w BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/ timeout 150 node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v -E '^\s*$' | tail -4; done
